title: Find The Least Frequent Digit
summary: Given an integer n, determine the digit that appears least frequently in its decimal representation.
statement: Given an integer n, determine the digit that appears least frequently in its decimal representation. If there are ties, select the smallest digit. Return this digit as an integer.
constraints: Count digits that actually appear in n.
Return the digit with the smallest frequency.
Break equal-frequency ties by the smaller digit.
hints: Count only decimal digits present in n.
Rank each by frequency first and numeric digit second.
The minimum tuple selects least frequency and then smallest digit.
Return the digit component as an integer.
editorial: Return the digit component as an integer.

tests.explanation: Digit one appears once while two, three, and five appear twice, so return one.
Digits zero and nine tie twice; zero is smaller.
